name: query_repeat
description: Reference-unique ACGT occurs twice in the same query; MUM must be empty.

name: both_unique
description: The entire eight-base sequence occurs once on each side.

name: reference_repeat
description: ACGT occurs twice in the reference; only MEM retains both hits.

name: overlapping_query
description: AA has overlapping query occurrences at 0, 1 and 2.

name: homopolymer
description: Five pairwise MEMs in AAAA vs AAAA; maximality is diagonal-specific.

name: nested_diagonals
description: The two length-two offset AC matches are valid MEMs inside the coordinate rectangle of the length-four match.

name: no_match
description: Neither forward nor reverse query has a two-base exact match.

name: suffix_overrun
description: A reference suffix shorter than the whole query must not be reported at query length.

name: reference_boundary
description: Joining r1 and r2 would invent AACC across the reference boundary.

name: query_boundary
description: Joining q1 and q2 would invent AACC across the query boundary.

name: reference_global_unique
description: Identical sequence in two reference records invalidates MAM and MUM uniqueness.

name: query_record_unique
description: Identical sequence in distinct query records is unique within each query and is a MUM for each.

name: reverse_offset
description: Reverse match starts at 1 in reverse-complement coordinates and at 2 in original query coordinates.

name: palindrome
description: Palindromic ACGT has distinct forward and reverse matches at the same coordinates.

name: mixed_case
description: FASTA DNA input is case-insensitive.

name: ambiguity_barrier
description: Under strict ACGT / official -n, N terminates exact matches.

name: ambiguous_query_repeat
description: N separates two overlapping-match groups; it cannot participate in an exact match.

name: below_threshold
description: All records are shorter than the requested minimum length.

name: terminal_suffix
description: The matching reference suffix ends exactly at the record boundary.

name: internal_maximal
description: A three-base match has mismatches on both flanks.

name: tandem_overlap
description: Alternating repeat copies overlap; every maximal diagonal must be retained for MEM.

name: multiple_records_reverse
description: Several records combine forward, reverse and absent matches.

name: iupac_barriers
description: Every non-ACGT IUPAC code is a barrier under -n.

name: lexicographic_mismatch
description: The suffix AT is lexicographically above AA, but is not an exact occurrence; lookup must return empty.
